title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gcc security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for the gcc compiler packages addressing two vulnerabilities: an integer wrap in the std library (CVE-2026-114691) and a confirmed out-of-bounds read/write in the libstdc++ parallel std library (CVE-2026-114690). These issues affect multiple architectures of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and related products. The update is rated as having a moderate security impact. No CVSS score is provided in the advisory, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
